title: Recover your work?
message: StarLight did not close properly. Automatically saved work is available{when} ({source}).
sourceUnsaved: work not yet saved to a project
explainProject: If you recover it, the project opens with the unsaved changes, and you decide whether to save them over the project. If you discard it, the copy is deleted.
explainUnsaved: If you recover it, it opens as untitled work that you can save to a project. If you discard it, the copy is deleted.
